sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLII OF 1965
ORDINANCE XLII OF 1965
DETENTION OF ENEMY
SHIPS, AIRCRAFT AND GOODS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965
An Ordinance to amend
the Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft
and Goods Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 15th October 1965]
No. F. 24(1)/65-Pub.---The following Ordinance
made by the President on the 15th October 1965, is hereby published for general
information :
Whereas it is expedient
to amend the Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1965 (XXX
of 1965), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas a
Proclamation of Emergency issued under clause (1) of Article 30 of the
Constitution is in force;
And whereas the
President is satisfied that immediate legislation is necessary to meet the
emergency;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (4) of Article 30 of the
Constitution, and of all other powers enabling him in that behalf, the
President is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordi nance :‑
1. Short title and commencement. (1) This Ordinance may
be called the Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

3. Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XXX
of 1965. In
the said Ordi nance, in section 2, after subsection (3), the following new
subsection shall be added and shall be deemed always to have been so added,
namely:
"(4) For the removal
of doubts, it is hereby declared that, in this Ordi nance, "ship"
includes every description of vessels, boats and crafts, whether sea-going or
ordinarily plying on inland waters, with the tackle, furniture and apparel of
the ship, vessels, boat or craft."
